# Pagination

> Buttons for moving between pages, with an ellipsis for the ones it doesn't show.

`<slab-pagination>` · Navigation · built on `<nav> + <button>s`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/pagination/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/pagination.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-pagination page="1" total="20"></slab-pagination>
```

When it dispatches "change", read the new `page` and navigate.

## Elements

### `<slab-pagination>`

Import `slab-elements/pagination.js` to register it.

Pagination with no visual styles: a `<nav>` around a list of `<button>`s, one for each page shown, between a previous and a next one.

The first and last pages are always shown, and so are `siblings` pages either side of the current one. The pages between those are an ellipsis, so there are always as many items, and the buttons don't move as the page changes.

The current page's button has `aria-current="page"`. Previous and Next are `aria-disabled` rather than `disabled` at either end, so focus stays on them when they reach it. Clicking a page sets `page` and dispatches "change".

Style it through its parts and `:state(first)` and `:state(last)`, which are set on the first and last pages. The current page's button is also `::part(current)`.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type     | Default | Description                                                                              |
| ------------------ | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `total` (required) | `number` |         | How many pages there are.                                                                |
| `label`            | `string` |         | Names the navigation. "Pagination" in English when unset.                                |
| `next-label`       | `string` |         | The next button's text and so its accessible name. "Next" in English when unset.         |
| `page`             | `number` | `1`     | The current page, from 1 to `total`.                                                     |
| `previous-label`   | `string` |         | The previous button's text and so its accessible name. "Previous" in English when unset. |
| `siblings`         | `number` | `1`     | How many pages are shown either side of the current one.                                 |

#### Properties

| Name        | Type                       | Description                                                                                                           |
| ----------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pageLabel` | `(page: number) => string` | Names each page's button, which shows only the number, from that number. "Page" and the number in English when unset. |

#### Events

| Name     | Type    | Description                                                             |
| -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `change` | `Event` | When the user goes to another page. Setting `page` doesn't dispatch it. |

#### CSS parts

| Name       | Description                             |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `current`  | The current page's button               |
| `ellipsis` | In place of the pages that aren't shown |
| `item`     | Each button's or ellipsis's list item   |
| `list`     | The buttons                             |
| `nav`      | The navigation                          |
| `next`     | The button to the next page             |
| `page`     | Each page's button                      |
| `previous` | The button to the previous page         |

#### CSS states

| Name            | Description                   |
| --------------- | ----------------------------- |
| `:state(first)` | While it's on the first page. |
| `:state(last)`  | While it's on the last page.  |
